text:
nick: heads up — deploybot held the cut: artifact-verify failed for api-bundle.tgz (checksum mismatch). holding promotion.

deploy-bot: [automatic] release/2026.09.01 job artifact-verify failed (checksum mismatch) — logs: https://ci.internal/1799999998 

anya: snippet? which runner?
nick: assemble-api step on eu-runner-3. log: 
```
VERIFY: api-bundle.tgz
expected sha256: aa11bb22cc33...
actual   sha256: aa11bb22cc34...
STATUS: MISMATCH (single-byte delta)
```

leo: smells like S3 MPU reassembly or ephemeral runner disk corruption. rerun could pass but rerun + checks = ~20m. change window 28m.
ops-oncall: rerun risk: might miss window. pinning to last-known-good unblocks but we must document and open follow-up.
anya: what's last-known-good?
nick: api-bundle.tgz@sha256:ffee1122 verified at 1799960000. I propose pin + small canary so PMs/docs can proceed.
leo: agree. rollout: pin -> 3% canary for 10m -> promote if metrics stable. rollback threshold: user-error delta >0.4% or 5xx spike.
ops-oncall: i'll watch dashboards and have escalation ready.
anya: i'll add a short line to release notes: "Pinned API bundle due to CI verify mismatch; full rerun & investigation scheduled post-release (ENG-5222)."
nick: executing pin + canary: 
```
deploybot pin --release release/2026.09.01 --component api --digest ffee1122
deploybot promote --release release/2026.09.01 --mode canary --percent 3 --duration 10m
```

deploy-bot: [automatic] pinned api to ffee1122; canary started 3% at 1799999930.
ops-oncall: first 6m look clean, latency and 5xx at baseline.
leo: ENG-5222 created with runner eu-runner-3 and s3-mpu-12 attached.
anya: canary healthy at 10m, promoting to 100% now. promote executed at 1799999958.
deploy-bot: [automatic] promote completed to 100% at 1799999960. release cut unblocked.
ops-oncall: follow-up: schedule rerun outside change window, attach full artifacts and compare byte-diff; consider adding post-assembly checksum on runner.
nick: ack. closing thread.
